content: Public bodies paid private consultants £3.4bn last year, a 62% increase since 2019-20, with spending remaining high following the Covid period. The government, led by Keir Starmer, aims to halve consultant spending during this parliament. Recent contracts include a £223m agreement with KPMG to train civil servants. Critics argue that consultants add little value given the complexity of organizations and the short time consultants spend on site. Is there anything else I can help with?
